description: Source code for NdkMediaMuxer, a native media muxer implementation for Android, providing functions to create, configure, and control media muxing operations.

classes.name: AMediaMuxer
classes.description: Structure representing a media muxer instance, encapsulating a pointer to the underlying MediaMuxerBase implementation.

methods.name: AMediaMuxer_new
methods.description: Creates a new AMediaMuxer instance with a file descriptor and output format.

methods.name: AMediaMuxer_setLocation
methods.description: Sets the geographical location metadata for the media.

methods.name: AMediaMuxer_setOrientationHint
methods.description: Sets the orientation hint for the media.

methods.name: AMediaMuxer_addTrack
methods.description: Adds a new track to the media muxer with specified format.

methods.name: AMediaMuxer_writeSampleData
methods.description: Writes sample data to a specified track.

methods.name: AMediaMuxer_append
methods.description: Creates a media appender for appending media data.

methods.name: AMediaMuxer_getTrackCount
methods.description: Returns the number of tracks in the media.

methods.name: AMediaMuxer_getTrackFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the format of a specified track.
